decks.notes: The main concept of this UR Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Subtlety and Tishana's Tidebinder, while utilizing other cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Expressive Iteration and Preordain help provide card selection and maintain a steady flow of resources. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control of the game and outlasting the opponent.

This deck focuses on cycling creatures to the graveyard and then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, enabling a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Subtlety to control the game while setting up for the combo. By utilizing cards like Architects of Will and Curator of Mysteries to cycle through the deck quickly, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces and execute the Living End play to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, players can search for specific creatures to match the current game state. Grist, the Hunger Tide serves as both a powerful threat and a way to generate tokens. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician provides card advantage and removal. The deck aims to control the board and generate value through creature interactions, ultimately leading to a winning combo or overwhelming board presence.

This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also leveraging powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Karn, the Great Creator to gain an advantage. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells and counter magic, while also using land destruction and artifact synergy to further hinder the opponent's strategy. The goal is to establish board dominance and disrupt the opponent's resources until the player can secure a win condition with powerful artifacts and efficient removal spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using creatures with haste and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana ramp and consistency to the deck. By utilizing a variety of land types, the Tribal Flames spell can deal significant damage, while Leylines provide protection and Leyline of the Guildpact boosts the power of multicolored creatures. The deck aims to maintain board control and apply constant pressure to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate additional mana and combo off with Primeval Titan to search for specific powerful lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The One Ring. The goal is to quickly ramp up mana production and play big threats like Cultivator Colossus and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to overwhelm the opponent. The deck's strategy revolves around efficient land sequencing and utilizing the synergy between lands and creatures to establish a dominant board presence and secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to generate massive amounts of mana and ramp quickly into Primeval Titan. The goal is to assemble the two-card combo of Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to enable explosive plays and quickly search for and play Primeval Titan. The deck includes other land tutors like Expedition Map and Tolaria West to find specific lands like Vesuva and utility lands like The Mycosynth Gardens. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful ramp, land synergies, and massive threats like Primeval Titan.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Kolaghan's Command. The key strategy is to use efficient removal spells to control the board, while utilizing creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes ways to bring back threats from the graveyard, such as Undying Evil and Not Dead After All, to maintain a steady onslaught.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The goal is to control the board early and consistently deal damage to the opponent, while also utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to disrupt their strategy. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. With a mix of efficient creatures and powerful removal spells, this deck aims to close out games swiftly and decisively.

This deck focuses on using cycling cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill the graveyard and then casting Living End to bring back powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves from the graveyard onto the battlefield. It also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The deck aims to control the game early on and then finish the opponent off with a powerful combo using Living End to overwhelm the board.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It combines elements of graveyard recursion with removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to control the board while setting up for explosive combos. The mana base is optimized for fetching lands with cards like Scalding Tarn and Bloodstained Mire, ensuring consistency in casting spells. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize adds disruption to the deck, allowing for strategic plays and resource management.

The deck focuses on utilizing land ramp and bounce effects to quickly ramp up mana and play big threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. It takes advantage of the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and the bounce lands, allowing for explosive turns and setting up strong board presence. The deck also includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and The Mycosynth Gardens to further enhance its combo potential. With the ability to generate a lot of mana quickly, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and efficient combos.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with unique abilities to create powerful combos. It utilizes tools such as Agatha's Soul Cauldron to sacrifice creatures and generate value, while also incorporating Yawgmoth, Thran Physician for additional synergy. The inclusion of creature toolbox cards like Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse allows for flexibility and adaptability in different matchups. With a mix of efficient mana acceleration and creature tutors, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a wide range of threats and disruptive options.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of disruption and resource denial. It combines early aggression with cards like Grief and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with disruption tools like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to combo with Primeval Titan and other cards to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. With the help of cards like Crumbling Vestige and Explore, the deck aims to ramp up mana production to cast Primeval Titan and search for key lands such as The Mycosynth Gardens and The One Ring. By utilizing Urza's Saga and Vesuva, the deck can further accelerate its mana production and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Cultivator Colossus and Slayers' Stronghold.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to create infinite combos and generate value. The deck includes cards that allow for tutoring for specific creatures, sacrificing creatures for benefits, and creating an engine to continuously generate value. By using the toolbox of creatures available, players can adapt to different situations and find the optimal path to victory by assembling key combinations to overwhelm the opponent. The deck's strategy relies on synergy between creatures and careful planning to execute powerful combos.
